chapter: Louis Armstrong and leaving New Orleans
title: National Park and Louis wearing short pants
summary: National Park at Third and Willow was a summer open ballpark dance.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: We didn't have any cover. Louie was wearing short pants then? Yeah. Sure. Black Benny had him tied on a string? No, tied with his. To the wrist, like a handcuff, you know. Why? So he wouldn't get lost in the crowd. Wouldn't come down in the arms.
When would you say this was, National Park? Yeah, Third and Willow. Third and Willow? Was this the same kind of place like Lincoln Park, that kind of a place?

It was open there, and park, just like a baseball park. I see. After the game, they put a big platform down and put all the balls up, you know, for beer and food and stuff. In the summertime, it was around, not year-round, you know.
There was parking jam. And then Louie, Louie finally joined your band?
